liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Box of Rain** (4 reviews, 1 other source): Phil's Box of Rain set off jubilation in the audience; A friend attending his first show said beforehand that Box of Rain was all he wanted to hear [1][17][22][24][25]
- **Althea** (1 review): Jerry forgot most of the lyrics; Bob then said practice makes perfect before Box of Rain [18]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd86-03-20 01 Crowd Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd86-03-20 02 Touch Of Grey**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd86-03-20 03 Little Red Rooster**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd86-03-20 04 Friend Of The Devil**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd86-03-20 05 It's All Over Now**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd86-03-20 06 Row Jimmy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd86-03-20 07 Me & My Uncle**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd86-03-20 08 Mexicali Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]

## The recordings

- **gd1986-03-20.140273.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 136 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd86-03-20.sbd-matrix.munder.8098.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 137 min; rated 3.32/5 by 25 [2]. Said about its sound: Matrix is far better than earlier audience copies, combining atmosphere with clear quality; Reviewer says sound is poor and this is not a true soundboard [17][27]
- **gd86-03-20.sony.lai.3906.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 143 min; rated 3.67/5 by 6 [5]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds distant with very loud crowd; show is faint in background [26]
- **gd1986-03-20.151197.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 136 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer got engaged at the show; the crowd was among the loudest he experienced [18]
- After Box of Rain, Phil said the band would be right back, instead of Bob [27]
- Brent noodled along with Mickey and Bill before Drums [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1986-03-20.140273.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Charlie Miller, Jim Wise, Scott Clugston; source: Source Info: (FOB) Schoeps CMC4/MK41 > Oade M118 > Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM (unknown deck/hardware/software) > hard disk > Adobe Audition… [1]
- **gd86-03-20.sbd-matrix.munder.8098.sbeok.shnf**: source: Matrix SBD>MC>C>CD [2]. Also: Reviewer says the recording came from the taper's rig: AKG 460 B microphones into a modified D5; Matrix source transferred via Jim Skinner, with minor digital noise noted, and seeded to etree by Willy [2][28]
- **gd86-03-20.sony.lai.3906.sbeok.shnf**: source: aud> sony mics> cassette master> cdr [5]
- **gd1986-03-20.151197.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [6]. Also: Master cassette from Michael Hessberg; Oade Schoeps source supplies a 36-second patch in the Drums > Space transition [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by The Music Never Stopped: [Grateful Dead Live at Hampton Coliseum on 03/20/1986](https://dayofthedeadshow.home.blog/2019/03/20/grateful-dead-live-at-hampton-coliseum-on-03-20-1986/) [30]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1986-03-21 Hampton Coliseum, Hampton, VA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1986-03-21-hampton-coliseum-hampton-va-usa/) [31]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1986-03-19 Hampton Coliseum, Hampton, VA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1986-03-19-hampton-coliseum-hampton-va-usa/) [32]
- Poster by Jerrybase: [Grateful Dead – 1986-03-19](https://jerrybase.com/events/19860319-01) [33]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1986-03-21 Hampton Coliseum, Hampton, VA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1986-03-21-hampton-coliseum-hampton-va-usa/) [34]
